title: Latency, Throughput and the Numbers Every Engineer Should Know
description: The order-of-magnitude latencies that make a capacity estimate credible on a whiteboard.
learning_objectives: Recall the latency of memory, SSD, disk seek and a cross-region round trip
Convert between requests per second and peak concurrency
Use Fermi estimation to sanity-check a design

title: CAP Theorem and Consistency Models
description: What CAP actually constrains, and the practical consistency choices it implies.
learning_objectives: State CAP precisely without the common misstatement
Match an application to strong, eventual or causal consistency
Explain PACELC's latency trade-off

title: Load Balancing and Service Discovery
description: Distributing traffic, health checking, and how clients find healthy instances.
learning_objectives: Choose between L4 and L7 balancing for a workload
Compare round robin with least-connections and consistent hashing
Design health checks that remove bad instances quickly

title: Caching Strategies and Eviction
description: Cache-aside, write-through and write-behind, plus invalidation and stampede control.
learning_objectives: Pick a cache write strategy per access pattern
Prevent a cache stampede on a hot key
Reason about staleness and invalidation scope

title: Database Indexing and Query Planning
description: How indexes change the cost of a query, and when they stop helping.
learning_objectives: Read a query plan and identify a missing index
Design a composite index for a filter plus sort
Recognise write-amplification cost of over-indexing

title: Sharding and Partitioning
description: Splitting data across nodes while keeping queries and hotspots manageable.
learning_objectives: Choose a shard key that avoids hotspots
Handle a shard rebalance without downtime
Decide between range, hash and directory sharding

title: Replication, Quorums and Failover
description: Leader-follower and quorum replication, read-your-writes, and split-brain avoidance.
learning_objectives: Compare synchronous and asynchronous replication
Guarantee read-your-writes for a user
Prevent split-brain during a partition

title: Message Queues and Event Streaming
description: Decoupling producers from consumers, and the delivery guarantees each broker offers.
learning_objectives: Choose between a queue and a log for a use case
Handle at-least-once delivery with idempotent consumers
Design a dead-letter path for poison messages

title: Idempotency and Exactly-Once Semantics
description: Why retries are inevitable, and how to make repeated operations harmless.
learning_objectives: Design an idempotency-key scheme for a payment API
Distinguish idempotent from exactly-once processing
Detect and discard duplicate side effects

title: Monitoring, Alerting and SLOs
description: Measuring a system's health in a way that produces actionable alerts.
learning_objectives: Define SLIs and an SLO with an error budget
Alert on symptoms rather than causes
Instrument a service for latency percentiles

title: Design a URL Shortener
description: The entry-level design: key generation, storage, redirection and analytics.
learning_objectives: Generate short keys without collisions
Serve redirects with minimal latency
Estimate storage growth and read/write ratio

title: Design a Rate Limiter at Scale
description: Distributed rate limiting where state cannot live in one process.
learning_objectives: Choose an algorithm that tolerates bursts correctly
Keep counters consistent across nodes
Fail open or closed deliberately during an outage

title: Design a Chat / Messaging System
description: Real-time delivery, ordering, presence and offline message history.
learning_objectives: Deliver messages in order per conversation
Handle presence and fan-out for group chats
Store and page message history efficiently

title: Design a News Feed
description: The fan-out-on-write versus fan-out-on-read trade-off, made concrete.
learning_objectives: Choose a fan-out strategy for celebrity and normal users
Rank a feed with bounded latency
Keep feed generation incremental

title: Design a Video Streaming Platform
description: Upload, transcoding pipeline, adaptive bitrate delivery and CDN strategy.
learning_objectives: Design an asynchronous transcoding pipeline
Choose a chunking and bitrate ladder
Serve video from the edge with correct caching

title: Design a Ride-Hailing Service
description: Geospatial matching, live location tracking and trip state.
learning_objectives: Index locations for nearby-driver queries
Match drivers without double-assigning
Track live positions at scale

title: Design a Distributed Job Scheduler
description: Reliable scheduling with retries, leases and exactly-one execution.
learning_objectives: Prevent duplicate execution of a scheduled job
Lease work so a dead worker's job is recovered
Handle misfires and clock skew

title: Design a Payment / Ledger System
description: Double-entry accounting, idempotent payments and reconciliation.
learning_objectives: Model money movement as double-entry postings
Make a payment API safe to retry
Reconcile internal state against a provider

title: Design a Search Autocomplete
description: Low-latency prefix suggestions built from aggregated query logs.
learning_objectives: Build and serve a prefix index
Aggregate query logs into ranked suggestions
Bound tail latency on a hot endpoint

title: Design a Collaborative Document Editor
description: Concurrent editing with conflict-free merging and offline support.
learning_objectives: Compare operational transforms with CRDTs
Keep replicas convergent after concurrent edits
Support offline editing and later merge
